The key value is ueber takes dative for location and accusative for direction, so ueber dem Tisch is location and ueber den Tisch is direction..
questions.hint: ueber takes dative for location, accusative for direction.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: The generalising pronoun man
questions.learningObjective: Use the pronoun man

stimulus.body: The note describes a general action without a specific subject. The writer chooses a pronoun.

questions.stem: In einer Standortbewertung, which sentence correctly uses the generalising pronoun man?

options.text: Mann kann das leicht uebersetzen
options.misconception: confuses the pronoun with the noun Mann

options.text: Man kann das leicht uebersetzen
Man kann das leicht uebersetzen nicht
Man koennen das leicht uebersetzen
options.misconception: uses plural verb with singular pronoun

questions.explanation: man is the generalising pronoun and takes a singular verb, so Man kann is correct; confusing it with Mann, misplacing negation, or using a plural verb are errors.
questions.hint: man takes a singular verb.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: The two cases of the preposition entlang
questions.learningObjective: Use entlang with correct case

stimulus.body: In einer Grammatikübung wird die Form verlangt, die der Regel der Stunde entspricht.

questions.stem: Welche Antwort entspricht der Regel der Stunde?

options.text: entlang der Kuestes is wrong gender
entlang der Kueste is wrong case
options.misconception: uses dative instead of genitive or accusative

options.text: entlang der Kueste or die Kueste entlang are both used
entlang die Kueste is missing the preposition position

questions.explanation: Entlang can precede a genitive or follow an accusative noun, so both forms are used; dative, wrong gender, and misplaced forms are errors. The key is C, "entlang der Kueste or die Kueste entlang are both used". Option A ("entlang der Kuestes is wrong gender") is wrong: uses wrong gender genitive form. Option B ("entlang der Kueste is wrong case") is wrong: uses dative instead of genitive or accusative. Option D ("entlang die Kueste is missing the preposition position") is wrong: misplaces entlang without accusative.
questions.hint: entlang takes genitive before or accusative after.
